title: Pattanathil Sundaran
desc: Sundaresan, a grocery store owner, marries an educated girl who gets a good job in another city soon after the wedding. Though he follows her to the new city, he plots so that she resigns.

title: Maattrraan
desc: A pair of conjoined twins strive to save their father's flourishing business from a spy. However, just before the spy is killed, they make a shocking revelation that may affect their lives forever.

title: Jana
desc: Jana staunchly defends his villagers against Veerapandi's atrocities. However, Veerapandi's daughter, Manimegalai, falls for Jana, only to be stunned by revelations about his past.

title: Sillunu Oru Kaadhal
desc: After reading her husband's old diary, a wife learns about his intense college romance, prompting her to reevaluate their seemingly perfect life together.

title: 365 Repeat the Year
desc: A detective and a webtoon artist gets a chance to reset their lives by a year, but their new reality takes an unexpected turn with mysterious and dangerous consequences.

title: Paiyaa
desc: Shiva, an unemployed graduate, falls in love with Charulatha. However, when on Charulatha's request, he drives her to Mumbai, the two are chased down by two different gangs for different reasons.
